snippet.title: Not My War - Beta Gameplay Trailer | Stealth. Survive. Escape.
snippet.description:
🎮 Get a look at gameplay in this trailer of the Beta for the upcoming stealth-exploration game, Not My War.

🦡 A deadly island. Relentless machines. One clever ferret's fight for survival.
🤖 Explore, survive, and escape an island overrun by deadly robots. Play as a clever ferret stranded on an unknown island where every second counts. Not My War is a 3D isometric stealth and exploration game with a day-night cycle that turns time against you.
⏰ Gather resources, help survivors, and repair your boat before it's too late… while relentless machines patrol the island.

📅 Not My War launches November 2025 for PC.

👉🏻 Wishlist now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4034810/Not_My_War/

Developed by 24-Pack Studios.
